Name: Manasseh, King of Judah
Summary: Manasseh reigned fifty-five years, rebuilt the high places his father had removed, set idols in the temple, and shed innocent blood, filling Jerusalem with evil that hastened Judah's judgment.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 21:1; 2 Kings 21:18; Jeremiah 15:4; 1 Chronicles 3:13; 2 Chronicles 33:1; 2 Chronicles 33:12; 2 Chronicles 33:15
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Hephzibah, Mother of Manasseh; Amon, King of Judah; King Josiah
LifeLesson: A father's faith is not inherited: Hezekiah's son undid his father's reforms in a single reign.
